subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent handoff stalls after delivered child result

question: Should the repair make requester wake-up durable through the canonical session/yield state, or should the existing direct-child registry own settled-run re-evaluation for the requester turn?
rationale: The report identifies two plausible ownership models, and selecting one may affect session-state and persistence boundaries that cannot be safely inferred without inspecting current-main implementation and owner intent.

options.title: Choose canonical durable yield ownership
options.body: Define the durable session/yield contract first, then implement the wake and synthesis repair with focused regression coverage.

options.title: Confirm registry-only ownership
options.body: Keep state ephemeral only if maintainers confirm the direct-child registry already owns all required settled-run re-evaluation semantics.

recommendation.title: Choose canonical durable yield ownership
recommendation.body: Define the durable session/yield contract first, then implement the wake and synthesis repair with focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the deterministic reproduction and the diagnostics that narrow the failure to requester synthesis/wake, though current-main ownership history still needs verification.
